specTitle: Test Case 1: Navigate to UD Loans Payment Guide page via Loan Payment Guides dropdown
title: AC1: Navigate to Loan Payment Guides Page and select UD Loans
preconditions: User is on the UnionDigital Bank homepage (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en
2. Click on 'Loan Payment Guides' nav item
3. Click on 'UD Loans' link in the dropdown
expected: UD Loans Payment Guide page is displayed at https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify '+' expand icon is visible on UD Loans Payment Guide accordion
title: ED-74 AC1: Validate Expand Option - '+' icon visible on 'How To Pay Your UD Loans'
preconditions: User navigates directly to the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Verify the page heading 'UD LOANS PAYMENT GUIDES' is visible
3. Locate the accordion item 'How To Pay Your UD Loans'
4. Verify the accordion button is in collapsed state (aria-expanded='false')
5. Verify the '+' icon is displayed to the right of 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' text
expected: The accordion item 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' is visible and its expand button has aria-expanded='false', confirming the '+' icon is rendered on the right side of the text
